shall_statement: Software shall preserve SI unit consistency across all physics modules without undocumented scaling
rationale: Dimensional consistency prevents silent catastrophic trajectory calculation errors
expected_result: All accelerations in m/s^2, forces in N, pressures in Pa

shall_statement: Software shall maintain orthogonal coordinate transformations with det(R) = +1.0
rationale: Non-orthogonal or reflection transforms distort physical geometry and orbital planes

shall_statement: Software shall strictly preserve unmodeled or missing telemetry channels as null/None
rationale: Falsifying unmodeled values as zero distorts physical analysis and graphs
input_fixture: Orbit phase records without aero channels

shall_statement: Orbit integrator shall conserve specific orbital energy and angular momentum during two-body conservative coast
rationale: Conservative Hamiltonian dynamical systems must preserve integrals of motion
expected_result: Energy and angular momentum remain constant over 3 orbits
caveat: Valid only for pure central gravity

shall_statement: Orbital J2 nodal regression rate shall agree with first-order secular perturbation theory
rationale: Verifies numerical implementation of Earth oblateness force field

shall_statement: Numerical trajectory solvers shall exhibit monotonic step-size and tolerance convergence
rationale: Ensures discretization error reduces as integration tolerance is refined

shall_statement: Software shall ensure continuous kinematic handoff across staging, orbit, and reentry boundaries
source_ref: NASA Systems Eng Handbook App. D
rationale: Interface discontinuities create unphysical velocity spikes and energy jumps
input_fixture: Staging SECO and 120km entry interface states
expected_result: Position difference < 1.0 m, velocity difference < 0.01 m/s

shall_statement: Full mission propellant and payload mass balance shall satisfy mass conservation equation
rationale: Vehicle mass cannot vanish or spontaneously increase without physical expenditure

shall_statement: Software shall strictly isolate Planned Flight 14 reference from Observed Reconstruction
rationale: Planned timeline cannot be confused with actual flown anomalies and early return
expected_result: Planned and Observed exist as separate isolated profiles

shall_statement: Observed profile shall document upper-stage engine shutdown anomaly and early return outcome
rationale: Reflects factual flight outcome without fabricating private sensor logs
expected_result: Upper stage engine anomaly recorded with source provenance
caveat: Cited to AP / Reuters wire reports

shall_statement: Observed profile shall document exactly 26 Starlink V3 satellites deployed into orbit
rationale: Public reporting confirms discrete deployment success of all 26 satellites
expected_result: Exactly 26 satellites with mass 1750 kg listed

shall_statement: Software shall classify Flight 14 end-of-mission as Northern Pacific ocean splashdown (expended)
rationale: Flight 14 was an expended test; vehicle was not recovered via vertical landing or tower catch
input_fixture: Reentry terminal state and dashboard banner
expected_result: Sea-level splashdown at terminal velocity; synthetic banner on Phase 7
caveat: Phase 7 landing isolated in synthetic lab

shall_statement: Orbital ephemeris shall be independently cross-verified against NASA GMAT R2026a
rationale: Independent verification against verified astrodynamics suite
expected_result: Ephemeris SMA and eccentricity residuals within tolerance
caveat: Matched ECI frame, epoch, and J2 model

shall_statement: Propellant tank membrane stress shall be independently verified against Roark formulas
rationale: Validates structural finite element formulation against closed-form benchmark
input_fixture: CalculiX CCX S4R cylindrical tank deck
expected_result: FEA hoop stress matches p*r/t formula (675.0 MPa)

shall_statement: Aerothermal stagnation flux shall be verified against Detra-Kemp-Riddell benchmark
rationale: Validates convective heat transfer model against classic hypersonic correlation
expected_result: q_DKR / q_SG ratio matches theoretical ratio 0.7075

shall_statement: Software shall implement reproducible Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification pipeline
rationale: Quantifies output dispersion from input parameter distributions with fixed RNG seed
input_fixture: Seeded parameter distributions (thrust, mass, drag, atm density)
expected_result: Outputs empirical percentiles (P5, P50, P95) and convergence trace

shall_statement: Software shall perform global parameter sensitivity screening for trajectory drivers
rationale: Identifies dominant physical parameters affecting Max-Q, peak heating, and apogee

shall_statement: The complete repository verification test suite shall execute with 100% pass rate
rationale: Release gate requires zero failing regression tests across all phases
expected_result: All 188+ test cases execute and PASS without errors
